'''CC-8675''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. CC-8675 fought in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]], and on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. CC-8675's actions during the battles earned them the promotion to [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]].

==Biography==
===The war begins===
CC-8675 was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]<ref name="CTP&PV" /> created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. CC-8675 was made to serve as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="db" />

CC-8675 first saw deployment as a [[Shiny/Legends|shiny]] new clone trooper on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] as one of the many clones sent into the [[Petranaki arena]] to evacuate the captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. In the arena, CC-8675 fought and destroyed multiple [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2-Series]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]]. Once all the Jedi were evacuated, CC-8675 returned to the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT gunship]] and accompanied [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to the location of a Republic broadcast. Upon arrival, a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] briefed them on their objective to infiltrate a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]] and destroy its towers. CC-8675 accompanied the group of clones as they traversed the inner workings of the plant, eventually locating the generator. After fighting off droid forces, CC-8675 took down the generator's shield by shooting multiple strategic points. Once the shield was down, CC-8675 opened fire on the generator, destroying it. CC-8675 and the rest of the clones then left the power plant as it began to explode.<ref name="CTP&PV" />

Soon after, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was spotted riding away on his [[Flitknot speeder/Legends|Flitknot speeder]]. CC-8675 hopped on a [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]] and began chasing Dooku through the [[Desert/Legends|desert]]. The pursuit was seen by super battle droids who opened fire at the clone, and subsequently Dooku as well. Annoyed by the droids' actions, Dooku disembarked from his speeder and, with the aid of the super battle droids, faced CC-8675. CC-8675 fired at Dooku and the droids, occupying him long enough for an LAAT gunship to arrive, forcing Dooku to flee aboard his speeder. Though CC-8675 wanted to continue the chase, the clone was ordered to fall back.<ref name="CTP&PV" />

===Defending Kamino===
As the Clone Wars continued, CC-8675's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Kamino became [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|under attack]] by droid forces. Under the [[Water/Legends|water]], CC-8675 operated a [[Kamino submarine/Legends|Kamino submarine]] in search of fallen debris that [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|''Trident''-class assault ships]] were hiding among. During the search, CC-8675 encountered and fought off many [[Aqua droid/Legends|aqua droids]]. The clone eventually found and began to pursue one of the Trident ships, but CC-8675 could not keep up and it got away. CC-8675 returned to base where the Trident ships were attacking the city. CC-8675 was called up to the training grounds to help fend off the infiltrated droids. Together, the clones were able to push the battle droids back and clear the training grounds. CC-8675 and the group moved on to clearing out the hallways where the droid forces blew open a hole in the wall.<ref name="CTP&PV" />

The squad then met up with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] who commanded them to clear out a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] and take down a Trident ship. CC-8675 and the other clones made their way through the hallways, now red with from the emergency lights, and towards the hangar, fighting droids in the process. Upon arrival at the hangar, the group fought wave of battle droids which included aqua droids, [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|B2-RP battle droids]], [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], and droidekas. At the exterior of the hangar, CC-8675 and the clones fought a Trident ship where they shot and damaged its legs to the point where it fell off the platform and plunged into the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] then appeared from behind the squad. Standing in her way, CC-8675 engaged in combat with Asajj Ventress, stalling her until Jedi General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived which forced her to retreat. After the ordeal, a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone lieutenant]] congratulated CC-8675 on their work in protecting [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], stating that they would become an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] in no time.<ref name="CTP&PV" />

===Information on Felucia===
Arriving on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], CC-8675 was briefed by Jedi Generals Anakin Skywalker and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] about a crashed Republic ship in the area. The ship contained vital Republic information that could not be allowed to get into the hands of the Separatists. With the goal of blowing up the ship, the group was just about to start the search for the crash site when an army of droids approached. Led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the droids attacked the landing site in an attempt to prevent the Republic from locating the crashed ship. CC-8675 and the other clones defended the landing site while Plo Koon searched for the ship. Upon locating the Republic ship, Koon ordered CC-8675 and the other clones to fall back to the gunship and head to his location.<ref name="CTP&PV" />

At the site, CC-8675 and their squad entered the wreckage and journeyed towards the ship's generators. Fighting their way through waves of battle droids, the squad traversed the wreckage and destroyed numerous generators, resulting in the complete destruction of the ship. Angered by CC-8675's success, General Grievous confronted the clone trooper. CC-8675 fought Grievous and his [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droid]], stalling him long enough for Anakin Skywalker and Plo Koon to arrive. At the sight of the two Jedi, Grievous hopped onto his [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]] and escaped into the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]. Soon after, CC-8675 was called to report to Kamino to attend a promotion ceremony. At the ceremony, Obi-Wan Kenobi announced that, due to CC-8675's actions on Geonosis, Kamino, and Felucia, they were promoted to [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]].<ref name="CTP&PV" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Jango Fett, CC-8675 shared Fett's [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin and height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="db" /> CC-8675 was considered a skilled combatant, which earned them a promotion to become an ARC trooper.<ref name="CTP&PV" />

==Equipment==
CC-8675 wore white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]].<ref name="CTP&PV" />

==Behind the scenes==
CC-8675 appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Trooper Plug & Play Videogame]]'' created by [[JAKKS Pacific]] and developed by [[Merge Interactive]].<ref name="CTP&PV" />
